sentences.en: Those who live in glass houses should not throw stones.
sentences.zh: 那些玻璃房子里住的人不应该扔石头。

sentences.en: The stone was so heavy that nobody could lift it.
sentences.zh: 这块石头太重了，没有人能搬起来。

sentences.en: The stone was inscribed with the date of his death.
sentences.zh: 这块石头刻着他的死亡日期。

senses.zh: 石，石头，石块，石料，(水果的)硬核，宝石，英石(重量单位，合，14磅)
向...扔石头，去掉(水果的)核
